notes: Fixes the black-video bug reported by the artifact audit. Root cause: TextToVideoSDPipeline returns HWC float32 frames in [0,1]; the old code did `np.asarray(f).astype(np.uint8)`, which truncates every value <1.0 to 0. New `_to_uint8_image` validates finiteness, clips to [0,1], multiplies by 255.0, rounds with np.rint, and casts to uint8. uint8 inputs are passed through untouched (no double scaling); non-uint8 integer inputs are only scaled when max<=1. Additionally, after conversion the run computes per-frame pixel std and raises RuntimeError if any frame is blank (std<=1.0) or non-finite, so a black output cannot be silently written - content_nonzero is only ever recorded as True. Seeds: unless `--seed` is passed explicitly, the per-request `seed` field (2026) is honored; `--seed N` makes scene i use N+i. All previously required behavior is retained: TextToVideoSDPipeline on CUDA fp16, 256x256, 16 frames, 12 steps, guidance 7.5, 8 fps, videos/<id>.mp4 + frames/<id>/frame_XXXX.png + index.jsonl + run.json with GPU-synchronized timings, decode verification, doctor returns 78/0 without loading models, hard failure when CUDA or inputs are missing, no mock weights/CPU fallback/network/shell.
